description: Money-code request service; the feature branch plants five defects and one harmless refactor.

defects.summary: list_page slices offset:offset+limit-1 and returns one item fewer than requested
the amount lower-bound guard was removed; zero and negative amounts are accepted
idempotency key lookup lost the company scope; a replay from another company returns that company's request
a discount of 0 is treated as missing and replaced by the 10% default
handle_cancel takes driver_id from the payload, so a caller can cancel another driver's request
